narr: Slow moving showers and thunderstorms amidst weak flow aloft resulted in flooding and flash flooding across portions of northern Virginia. Localized rainfall totals of two to four inches in about 90 minutes were observed along and north of I-66 towards the Potomac River.
ev: WTOP reporter noted 1.5 to 3 feet of standing water underneath the 267 Toll Road at Hunter Mill Road.
A 9 foot rise from 228 feet to 237 feet in 1 hour was observed between 425 and 525 PM at the stream gauge Hunter Mill Estates Regional Pond.
Reports of 6 inches of flowing water across Browns Mill Road where Difficult Run River runs.
Water from Lick Branch flowing across Catharpin Road between Catharpin Way and Executive Drive.
Lawyers Road closed at Soapstone Lane due to at least six to twelve inches of water flowing across the road.
At least 6 to 8 inches of flowing water on VA-28 around 1 mile south of Westfields Blvd. Road is closed.
At least 6 inches of water flowing across the road along Pageland Lane between Artemus Road.
Approximately 6 to 12 inches of water flowing over US-29 just to the west of Pleasant Valley Rd.
At least 12 inches of water reported flowing across Fairfax Station Road near Piney Branch.
